说就是，“要与立直对攻，自己要先听牌了”是基本；“一向听的话，就可以攻一巡”，这么记就好了。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0034","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0034","text":"为什么一向听一下不能对攻呢？","segments":[{"text":"为什么一向听一下不能对攻呢？","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0035","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0035","text":"自己听牌之前是不会有获得点棒的机会的。即使对攻，也不能保证下一巡能够维持听牌，说不定危险牌还回来。","segments":[{"text":"自己听牌之前是不会有获得点棒的机会的。即使对攻，也不能保证下一巡能够维持听牌，说不定危险牌还回来。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0036","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0036","text":"自己还没有听牌的时候切危险牌，只是给对手增加机会而已。","segments":[{"text":"自己还没有听牌的时候切危险牌，只是给对手增加机会而已。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0037","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0037","text":"宝牌2的一向听，听牌了的话，打点比较有优势。","segments":[{"text":"宝牌2的一向听，听牌了的话，打点比较有优势。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0038","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0038","text":"如同例3一样，那样的进张数要连续攻2次也是不利的。还是弃和比较好。","segments":[{"text":"如同例3一样，那样的进张数要连续攻2次也是不利的。还是弃和比较好。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0039","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0039","text":"理论：","segments":[{"text":"理论：","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0040","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0040","text":"攻守判断以向听数做主线是比较主流的方式。听牌的话就攻，一向听的话攻一次，两向听以下弃和是基本。","segments":[{"text":"攻守判断以向听数做主线是比较主流的方式。听牌的话就攻，一向听的话攻一次，两向听以下弃和是基本。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"id":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0041","type":"text","tag":"p","paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0041","text":"攻守判断想要模式化是非常困难的，所以下一节就不在打算再系统化了，而去考虑一下赤牌麻将中应该攻、还是该守的实例。","segments":[{"text ibili-cn:cv1793434:b0025:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0026"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0026","text":"【和牌的容易度】一向听，进张不太多了","sourceSegments":[{"text":"【和牌的容易度】一向听，进张不太多了","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0027"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0027","text":"【打点】门平宝牌1~3，足够了","sourceSegments":[{"text":"【打点】门平宝牌1~3，足够了","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0028"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0028","text":"【牌的危险度】没有通过的筋牌比较多，7万、5索都很危险","sourceSegments":[{"text":"【牌的危险度】没有通过的筋牌比较多，7万、5索都很危险","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0029"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0029","text":"【弃和成功率】现物两张、筋牌一张，估计能够弃和成功","sourceSegments":[{"text":"【弃和成功率】现物两张、筋牌一张，估计能够弃和成功","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0030"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0030","text":"除了基本的判断材料之外，南场的TOP立直，看来是想确定自己的领先优势。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"除了基本的判断材料之外，南场的TOP立直，看来是想确定自己的领先优势。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0031"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0031","text":"这样的状况下，为了减少自己的迷惑、冷静的进行攻守判断，有攻守判断的“脊柱”材料是非常重要的。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"这样的状况下，为了减少自己的迷惑、冷静的进行攻守判断，有攻守判断的“脊柱”材料是非常重要的。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0032"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0032","text":"这个讲座里，我比较推荐以“自己的向听数”来进行判断。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"这个讲座里，我比较推荐以“自己的向听数”来进行判断。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0033"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0033","text":"具体来说就是，“要与立直对攻，自己要先听牌了”是基本；“一向听的话，就可以攻一巡”，这么记就好了。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"具体来说就是，“要与立直对攻，自己要先听牌了”是基本；“一向听的话，就可以攻一巡”，这么记就好了。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0034"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0034","text":"为什么一向听一下不能对攻呢？","sourceSegments":[{"text":"为什么一向听一下不能对攻呢？","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0035"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0035","text":"自己听牌之前是不会有获得点棒的机会的。即使对攻，也不能保证下一巡能够维持听牌，说不定危险牌还回来。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"自己听牌之前是不会有获得点棒的机会的。即使对攻，也不能保证下一巡能够维持听牌，说不定危险牌还回来。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0036"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0036","text":"自己还没有听牌的时候切危险牌，只是给对手增加机会而已。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"自己还没有听牌的时候切危险牌，只是给对手增加机会而已。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0037"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0037","text":"宝牌2的一向听，听牌了的话，打点比较有优势。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"宝牌2的一向听，听牌了的话，打点比较有优势。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0038"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0038","text":"如同例3一样，那样的进张数要连续攻2次也是不利的。还是弃和比较好。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"如同例3一样，那样的进张数要连续攻2次也是不利的。还是弃和比较好。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0039"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0039","text":"理论：","sourceSegments":[{"text":"理论：","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0040"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0040","text":"攻守判断以向听数做主线是比较主流的方式。听牌的话就攻，一向听的话攻一次，两向听以下弃和是基本。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"攻守判断以向听数做主线是比较主流的方式。听牌的话就攻，一向听的话攻一次，两向听以下弃和是基本。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0041"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0 ibili-cn:cv1793434:b0025:figure"},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0026"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0026","text":"【和牌的容易度】一向听，进张不太多了","sourceSegments":[{"text":"【和牌的容易度】一向听，进张不太多了","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0027"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0027","text":"【打点】门平宝牌1~3，足够了","sourceSegments":[{"text":"【打点】门平宝牌1~3，足够了","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0028"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0028","text":"【牌的危险度】没有通过的筋牌比较多，7万、5索都很危险","sourceSegments":[{"text":"【牌的危险度】没有通过的筋牌比较多，7万、5索都很危险","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0029"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0029","text":"【弃和成功率】现物两张、筋牌一张，估计能够弃和成功","sourceSegments":[{"text":"【弃和成功率】现物两张、筋牌一张，估计能够弃和成功","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0030"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0030","text":"除了基本的判断材料之外，南场的TOP立直，看来是想确定自己的领先优势。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"除了基本的判断材料之外，南场的TOP立直，看来是想确定自己的领先优势。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0031"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0031","text":"这样的状况下，为了减少自己的迷惑、冷静的进行攻守判断，有攻守判断的“脊柱”材料是非常重要的。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"这样的状况下，为了减少自己的迷惑、冷静的进行攻守判断，有攻守判断的“脊柱”材料是非常重要的。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0032"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0032","text":"这个讲座里，我比较推荐以“自己的向听数”来进行判断。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"这个讲座里，我比较推荐以“自己的向听数”来进行判断。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0033"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0033","text":"具体来说就是，“要与立直对攻，自己要先听牌了”是基本；“一向听的话，就可以攻一巡”，这么记就好了。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"具体来说就是，“要与立直对攻，自己要先听牌了”是基本；“一向听的话，就可以攻一巡”，这么记就好了。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0034"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0034","text":"为什么一向听一下不能对攻呢？","sourceSegments":[{"text":"为什么一向听一下不能对攻呢？","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0035"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0035","text":"自己听牌之前是不会有获得点棒的机会的。即使对攻，也不能保证下一巡能够维持听牌，说不定危险牌还回来。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"自己听牌之前是不会有获得点棒的机会的。即使对攻，也不能保证下一巡能够维持听牌，说不定危险牌还回来。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0036"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0036","text":"自己还没有听牌的时候切危险牌，只是给对手增加机会而已。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"自己还没有听牌的时候切危险牌，只是给对手增加机会而已。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0037"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0037","text":"宝牌2的一向听，听牌了的话，打点比较有优势。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"宝牌2的一向听，听牌了的话，打点比较有优势。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0038"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0038","text":"如同例3一样，那样的进张数要连续攻2次也是不利的。还是弃和比较好。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"如同例3一样，那样的进张数要连续攻2次也是不利的。还是弃和比较好。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0039"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0039","text":"理论：","sourceSegments":[{"text":"理论：","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0040"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0040","text":"攻守判断以向听数做主线是比较主流的方式。听牌的话就攻，一向听的话攻一次，两向听以下弃和是基本。","sourceSegments":[{"text":"攻守判断以向听数做主线是比较主流的方式。听牌的话就攻，一向听的话攻一次，两向听以下弃和是基本。","marks":[],"href":null}],"tableContext":null},{"type":"text","sourceBlockIds":["79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:b0041"],"paragraphId":"79-bilibili-cn:cv1793434:p0
